config.title: Build disaster recovery simulation scripts

intro.title: Build disaster recovery simulation scripts
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a Node.js script that simulates a disaster recovery scenario, such as a server outage or data corruption, to practice automated response techniques. You will learn how to use core programming concepts like conditional logic and asynchronous operations to handle simulated failures and recovery steps. The main technologies involved include Node.js's built-in modules for file system operations and timers, along with basic JavaScript functions and error handling. By the end, you'll have a functional script that can mimic a disaster event and execute a predefined recovery plan, helping you understand the fundamentals of scripting for system resilience.
intro.usecase: Disaster recovery simulation scripts are essential for enterprise systems like banking platforms, e-commerce sites, and cloud infrastructure. Developers create these scripts to test backup restoration, database failover, and service redundancy in controlled environments before real outages occur. For example, a financial dashboard might use simulation scripts to verify transaction data recovery after a server crash, while cloud management consoles run them to validate multi-region deployment resilience. These automated tests give teams confidence that their recovery procedures will work when actual disasters strike.

objectives: Construct a Node.js script that simulates a server failure scenario
Implement automated backup verification using file system operations
Configure a recovery script to restore data from backup sources
Integrate error handling mechanisms to manage simulation failures
Manipulate system environment variables to control simulation parameters
Initialize logging systems to track recovery simulation progress
Apply conditional logic to determine recovery success criteria
